probable_cause: Sample probe partially occluded or pump seal worn
resolution: Run Fluidics Prime x3; if persistent replace probe seal kit VS4-SP-021

probable_cause: Clot in sample or dried reagent at probe tip
resolution: Perform Probe Unblock cycle; soak probe in RGT-CL for 15 min; escalate to FSE if repeated

probable_cause: Waste bottle at or above float sensor level
resolution: Empty waste per local biohazard policy and reseat float sensor connector

probable_cause: RGT-D5 cartridge empty or flow sensor cable disconnected
resolution: Check RGT-D5 volume; reseat cartridge; verify J14 cable at fluidics board

probable_cause: Cartridge changed without prime or seal breach in tubing
resolution: Run Reagent Prime; inspect cartridge septum for damage

probable_cause: Drain line kinked or waste pump underperforming
resolution: Straighten drain line; check waste pump duty cycle in Service > Diagnostics

probable_cause: Halogen lamp ageing (>2000 h) or dust on collector lens
resolution: Replace lamp assembly VS4-OPT-104; recalibrate optics

probable_cause: Flow cell contamination or protein deposit
resolution: Run Extended Clean with RGT-CL; if unresolved replace flow cell VS4-OPT-220

probable_cause: Lyse reagent degradation, incorrect lot, or optics drift
resolution: Verify RGT-L3 lot against current field notices; run Blank Cycle; recalibrate

probable_cause: Optics board drift or failed calibration bead lot
resolution: Repeat calibration with fresh VeriCal bead vial; if failed twice escalate

probable_cause: Laser diode degradation
resolution: Instrument requires FSE visit; do not attempt user repair

probable_cause: RFID tag unreadable or non-genuine cartridge
resolution: Reseat cartridge; clean RFID window; confirm cartridge is genuine VeriLyse stock

probable_cause: Cartridge past expiry or past 90-day on-board limit
resolution: Install in-date cartridge; record lot change per SOP-VBS-002

probable_cause: Cartridge nearly empty
resolution: Replace cartridge before starting batch

probable_cause: Diluent and lyse cartridges from incompatible formulation revisions
resolution: See lookup-reagent-compatibility.csv; install matched pair

probable_cause: Cartridge damaged in transit or over-torqued on insertion
resolution: Quarantine cartridge; photograph and raise support ticket with lot ID

description: Sample rotor home position not found
probable_cause: Rotor obstruction or home sensor fault
resolution: Clear obstruction; power cycle; if repeated replace sensor VS4-MEC-033

probable_cause: Cap material shed into needle path or bent needle
resolution: Power down; inspect needle; replace needle assembly VS4-MEC-011

probable_cause: Sensor contaminated or tube type unsupported
resolution: Clean sensor window; verify tube geometry against supported tube list

probable_cause: Mixer bearing seizure
resolution: FSE visit required; replace mixer assembly VS4-MEC-047

probable_cause: Network fault or LIS host unavailable
resolution: Check LAN link LED; ping host; verify VeriConnect connector status

probable_cause: Middleware not acknowledging or malformed MSH segment
resolution: See lookup-hl7-message-mapping.csv; check MSH-10 uniqueness

probable_cause: NTP unreachable or RTC battery low
resolution: Set NTP server in Settings > Time; replace RTC battery if drift >2 min/week

probable_cause: Interrupted update or corrupted USB media
resolution: Re-download image from VeriConnect > Fleet > Firmware; do not power cycle mid-update

probable_cause: RGT-RT stain degraded or retic flow cell fouled
resolution: Install fresh RGT-RT; run Retic Clean; recalibrate

probable_cause: Retic stain cartridge nearly empty
resolution: Replace RGT-RT cartridge

description: Retic flow cell temperature out of range
probable_cause: Heater element fault or ambient temperature outside limits
resolution: Confirm ambient within specification; if within limits raise FSE ticket

description: Body fluid mode background count exceeds limit
probable_cause: Carryover from previous whole blood sample
resolution: Run three background cycles before body fluid batch per SOP-VBS-001 s.7

description: Body fluid mode dilution factor invalid
probable_cause: Manual dilution factor entered outside 1:1 to 1:20
resolution: Re-enter valid dilution factor

probable_cause: Normal statistical variation or early reagent drift
resolution: Monitor; no action if single occurrence (Westgard 1-2s is warning only)

probable_cause: Reagent or calibration problem
resolution: Reject run; recalibrate; repeat QC before releasing patient results

probable_cause: Room temperature drift
resolution: See VBB-0052 for revised operating range; relocate or condition the room

probable_cause: On-board cartridge approaching 90-day limit
resolution: Order replacement stock

probable_cause: Lyse contamination, flow cell fouling, or affected RGT-L3 lot
resolution: Check lot against FSN-2025-003; run Extended Clean

probable_cause: Underfilled tube
resolution: Recollect sample; minimum 150 uL whole blood required
